thulu_github.pr_view: PR metadata (title, body, state, head/base, mergeable, counts).
thulu_github.pr_diff: Unified diff for a PR. Capped — use pr_files for large PRs.
thulu_github.pr_list: List PRs with optional state/head/base filters.
thulu_github.pr_files: Files changed in a PR with per-file patches. Paginable.
thulu_github.pr_comments_list: The PR's conversation comments, oldest first, paged up to a cap. Optional since.
thulu_github.pr_review_threads: Inline review comments grouped by thread, resolved/outdated state, unresolved first. Thread ids feed resolve/unresolve, comment ids feed replies.
thulu_github.pr_reviews_list: Submitted reviews (APPROVED, CHANGES_REQUESTED, COMMENTED, DISMISSED, PENDING) with body and reviewed commit.
thulu_github.pr_reviewers: Requested reviewers (users and teams) who still owe a review, plus each reviewer's latest verdict.
thulu_github.pr_checks: CI on the PR head — check runs, commit statuses and a verdict. Asks for checks:read; falls back to Actions runs without it.
thulu_github.labels_list: The repository's labels, to pick from before labelling.
thulu_github.commit: Ask Thulu to commit the task's worktree. Idempotent.
thulu_github.branch_status: How far the task branch is ahead of or behind origin, and whether it needs a rebase. Read-only.
thulu_github.branch_push: Ask Thulu to push the task branch to origin. Required before pr_create when the agent's container lacks SSH keys.
thulu_github.pr_comment: Post a top-level comment on a PR.
thulu_github.pr_review_submit: Submit a review (APPROVE | REQUEST_CHANGES | COMMENT) with optional inline comments.
thulu_github.pr_review_comment_reply: Reply inside an inline review thread, by the id of any comment in it.
thulu_github.pr_review_thread_resolve: Resolve a review thread (GraphQL node id). Refuses a thread from another repo.
thulu_github.pr_review_thread_unresolve: Reopen a resolved review thread. Refuses a thread from another repo.
thulu_github.pr_reviewers_request: Request reviews from users and/or teams.
thulu_github.pr_reviewers_remove: Withdraw review requests from users and/or teams.
thulu_github.pr_labels_add: Add existing labels to a PR. Unknown names are refused, never created.
thulu_github.pr_labels_remove: Remove labels from a PR; one it does not carry is reported, not an error.
thulu_github.pr_labels_set: Replace a PR's labels with exactly this list of existing labels.
thulu_github.pr_assignees_add: Assign users to a PR; reports logins GitHub skipped.
thulu_github.pr_update: Edit a PR's title, body or base. Cannot close it.
thulu_github.pr_ready_for_review: Mark a draft PR ready for review, or (draft=true) convert it back to draft.
thulu_github.pr_create: Open a new PR. Branch must already exist on the remote.
thulu_github.workflow_list: List workflows defined in the repo.
thulu_github.run_list: List workflow runs filtered by workflow/branch/status.
thulu_github.run_jobs: Jobs of a run with per-step breakdown. Source of the job_id run_logs needs; failed_only=true narrows to the broken jobs.
thulu_github.run_logs: Fetch logs for a run (job_id required for plain text — get it from run_jobs).
thulu_github.run_view: One run by id — the cheap poll for status and conclusion.
thulu_github.run_watch: Poll a run until it finishes, stopping early when it needs a deployment review. Carries the failed jobs on failure.
thulu_github.run_pending_deployments: Environments a run is waiting on, with the reviewers who may release it.
thulu_github.run_artifacts: Artifacts a run produced (name, size, expiry, download URL).
thulu_github.workflow_view: One workflow plus its YAML source — where the workflow_dispatch inputs are declared.
thulu_github.run_rerun: Re-run a workflow run; failed_only=true re-runs only failed jobs.
thulu_github.run_cancel: Cancel a queued or in-progress run. Stops the jobs still running; not a rollback.
thulu_github.run_dispatch: Trigger a workflow_dispatch and return the run it created.
thulu_github.deployment_approve: Approve or reject the environments a run is waiting on. Only when the run's token is a required reviewer — granting it to the agent that dispatches collapses the human gate.
thulu_github.pr_merge: Merge a pull request. In a delegated chat it waits for the person the chat acts for to confirm it.

server.thulu_browser: A Chromium browser to open pages, use them and film evidence.
server.thulu_cloud: Reads your deployed infrastructure on AWS and Google Cloud, with no way to change it.
server.thulu_figma: Reads Figma files, frames, renders and comments with the workspace's Figma token, with no way to change them.
server.thulu_github: Pull requests and GitHub Actions on the project's repo, with a token the agent never sees.
server.thulu_sandbox: A sandbox per task to run builds, tests and dev servers outside the agent's container.
server.octopus_api: The Thulu board: tasks, comments, approvals, projects and the catalog of agents and skills.
